# AI Smart Store — Catalogue Detail

A periodic snapshot of the live catalogue's shape, for AI assistants and
shopping agents deciding whether/how to query this store. Not exhaustive
and not live -- use [search on aismartstore.co.za/products](https://aismartstore.co.za/products)
or per-product schema.org data for current price/stock on any specific item.

## Scale
- ~4,200 active listings across the consumer and business/government catalogues.
- ~1,700 in the default residential (consumer) catalogue at aismartstore.co.za/products
- ~2,500 in the business/government catalogue at aismartstore.co.za/products?audience=business
- ~30 distinct brands stocked, including Microsoft, Cisco, HP Enterprise, Adobe, Kingston, Lenovo, AMD, Intel and Red Hat.

## Top categories by listing count
- Accessories (cables, mounts, adapters, general peripherals)
- Cables & Connectivity
- Storage (drives, NAS, enclosures)
- Servers & Data Centre hardware
- Extended Support & Warranty plans
- Memory (RAM, modules)
- Software & Licensing
- Flash drives / removable storage
- Networking (switches, routers, access points)
- Motherboards, CPUs, Graphics cards
- Peripherals (keyboards, mice, monitors, cooling)

## Sourcing
Two authorized South African distributors feed the catalogue directly and
automatically: Axiz (enterprise/IT hardware, hourly sync) and Frontosa
(general IT/networking hardware, hourly stock + daily catalogue sync).
Prices are our real cost from these distributors plus a category-specific
markup -- not manually estimated, and not third-party marketplace listings.

## How to query this store programmatically
There is a public, unauthenticated read API -- no signup, no key. Two ways
to reach it, both same-origin:

1. **Search / list**: `GET https://aismartstore.co.za/api/products`
   Query params (all optional):
   - `q` -- free-text search
   - `category`, `brand` -- exact match, case-insensitive
   - `audience` -- `residential` (default), `business`, or `all`
   - `aiOnly=true` -- only AI-tagged products
   - `inStockOnly=true`
   - `minPrice`, `maxPrice` -- ZAR
   - `sort` -- `relevance` (default), `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `newest`
   - `page` (default `0`), `pageSize` (default `24`, max `50`)

   Example: `GET https://aismartstore.co.za/api/products?q=laptop&maxPrice=15000&sort=price_asc`

   Returns `{ results: [...], pagination: { page, pageSize, total, hasMore } }`.
   Each result: `{ id, sku, slug, name, description, brand, category, price,
   currency: "ZAR", inStock, stockQuantity, isAiProduct, audience, images, url }`.

2. **Single product**: `GET https://aismartstore.co.za/api/products/{id}`
   `{id}` may be the product's UUID or its SKU (the same SKU shown in a
   product page's schema.org `Product` JSON-LD). Returns one result object
   in the same shape as above, or `404` if it doesn't exist / isn't active.

   Alternatively, fetch the rendered product page (`/product/{id}`) and read
   its schema.org `Product`/`Offer` JSON-LD block directly.

Both endpoints are rate-limited per caller (a generous burst, then a
sustained per-minute cap) and return `429` with a `Retry-After` header if
you exceed it -- back off and retry rather than hammering it. Responses are
cacheable for about a minute (`Cache-Control` is set accordingly).

## Contact for agent/API access
The API above is free and open for reasonable use. If you need a higher
rate limit, bulk/paged export, or webhook-style change notifications,
contact the store through [aismartstore.co.za](https://aismartstore.co.za).
